code_hints: Do not treat https://www.moncler.com/en-gb/ as a PLP; it is a homepage. If no product tiles are found after DOM ready, run fallback_navigation.
Always attempt to click #onetrust-accept-btn-handler if present before searching for tiles; retry selectors after dismissal.
When navigating via header, prefer anchor contains '/en-gb/men' then a category link containing 'ready-to-wear' or 'outerwear' or 'new-in'.
Wait for one of the product tile selectors (article[data-component='ProductTile'], li.product-tile, div.product-grid-item) before extracting.
For PDP price/title, attempt JSON-LD first; if unavailable, use price_fallback/title_fallback selectors provided.
Enable gentle infinite scroll on PLP to materialize tiles; stop after first page if tiles are present.
rationale: The failure occurred because the crawler landed on the Moncler homepage (not a PLP) and likely faced a cookie banner, so product tiles never appeared. We prioritize config-only fixes: accept the OneTrust cookie modal, add resilient PLP tile selectors, and provide a safe seed PLP URL plus a simple nav fallback from homepage to a category that yields product tiles. URL normalization forces en-gb and avoids locale traps or monclergroup.com hops.
